description: A brightly colored, standard-fab pattern environmental suit for use in industrial and medical settings.  Offers good protection from chemical and radioactive hazards, but is not insulated against heat or cold.  Requires a gas mask or sealed helmet for full protection.

use_action.msg: You slip out of the top of the suit and tie the sleeves around your waist.

description: A brightly colored, standard-fab pattern environmental suit for use in industrial and medical settings.  The upper portion has been tied around the waist casually.

use_action.msg: You untie the sleeves and put back on the top of the suit.
